spans.text: These Terms & Conditions apply to the TV Comic Book Reader application for Roku devices and Roku TV devices (the "Application"). The Application is provided by Deepak PK (the "Service Provider") as a local comic book reading utility for viewing supported comic archives on a TV.

Supported archive formats may include CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR.
